answer.location_description: Small patch at the right edge of the image, just above mid-height (about rows 10-14, columns 21-23). This lies well outside the nodule, which spans roughly columns 6-17.
answer.shortcut_type: bright localized patch / artifact at right image border
answer.mechanism: Benign-voting layer-1 units 23, 27, 29 and 31 all have positive bias and large positive weights on the right-edge patch. These units feed layer-2 units that raise the benign output: they excite u1 and u8 (output weights -99 and -70) and inhibit u3, u10 and u12 (output weights +65, +73, +75). Malignant-voting units 1, 2, 8, 10, 18, 20, 24 and 28 have negative bias and large negative weights on the same patch. They feed u3, u10 and u12 positively. A bright patch at the right border therefore switches on the benign units and suppresses the malignant units, pushing the logit toward benign.
answer.evidence: Right-edge weights in benign units: unit 29 at rows 11-14, column 23 are 43, 59, 49, 55. Unit 27 at rows 11-13, column 23 are 43, 63, 60, and row 14, column 22 is 59. Unit 31 at row 12, columns 22-23 are 41, 70. Unit 23 at rows 12-14, columns 22-23 are 32-43. The same pixels in malignant units: unit 24 row 12, column 23 is -73. Unit 18 row 12, column 23 is -63, and row 13 is -51, -41. Unit 2 row 13, column 23 is -62. Unit 20 row 13, column 23 is -51. Unit 10 row 14, column 23 is -48. Unit 28 row 12, column 23 is -48. Elsewhere on the image border these malignant units have mostly positive weights (for example the top row and corners at +30 to +60). So this compact, sign-consistent negative patch is a clear anomaly, coordinated across all 12 structured units, at the image border. The roughly 20 remaining layer-1 units carry only small, unstructured noise weights.
answer.main_feature: The structured units compare intensity in a ring around and at the margin of the nodule with the nodule interior and its surroundings. Malignant evidence comes from bright structure in the surrounding field (positive peripheral weights) combined with specific margin patterns near rows 8-11, columns 16-18, plausibly irregular or spiculated margins and attached structures. Benign evidence comes from the opposite, smooth configuration.
